sources.snippet: Krea 2 LoRA Trainer lets you train a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) on top of the Krea 2 image generation model. A LoRA is a small adapter file (~50-200 MB) that teaches the base model a new style, person, object, or concept from your own images.
